# Fragment

GameCore theme sourced from a **real design object** in the Art Institute of Chicago.

## Work
- **Title:** Fragment
- **Artist / Maker:** Egypt
- **Date:** 4th-5th century
- **Style / Period:** coptic (historically identified as)
- **Classification:** textile
- **Department:** Textiles
- **AIC artwork ID:** 1841
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/1841
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/594987cd-fea0-dc02-97c6-9ca20aa73b79/full/400,/0/default.jpg
